html:
The Yilba are an Aboriginal people of north Queensland, in inland country west of Bowen, around the upper Bowen and Suttor rivers in the Burdekin basin.

Their neighbours on the map include the Birria to the west, the Yirandali further inland and the Barada Barna to the southeast. Pastoral runs spread into the Burdekin country in the early 1860s, soon after Bowen was founded in 1861. Little else is recorded about them as a separate group. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Yilba are an Aboriginal people of north Queensland, in inland country west of Bowen, around the upper Bowen and Suttor rivers in the Burdekin basin.
